description: A shopping bag review page with quantity steppers, removable line items, and a totals summary.
overview: A shopping bag page that leads with the order total, then lists each item with a photo, a quantity stepper, its price and a Remove link, followed by subtotal, shipping and total. Line items use a compact two-column layout on mobile and a four-column row on desktop. Removing everything turns the headline into an empty-bag message. Reach for it for any cart or order review screen.
usage: Replace `initialItems` with your cart lines, each with a name, variant, price, image and quantity. Persist quantity changes and removals to your cart service, and connect both Check Out buttons to your checkout. The product links point to `#details`, and the free delivery and shipping copy is placeholder text. In the empty state, Continue Shopping restores the sample items, so point it at your catalog instead.
notes: Quantities are limited to 1–10, and each stepper and Remove button is labeled with the product name. Product photos are Unsplash placeholders.
